# Ploid

## People search for AI agents, across 2B+ profiles

6 followers

## People search for AI agents, across 2B+ profiles

6 followers

Ploid is a people search engine with a living index of over two billion people. Search by role, company, skills or location, get up to 150 results per request, and merge someone's professional, social and personal sites into one Superprofile. Agents can reason over posts, photos and talks, not just database fields. Available as API, CLI and MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Cursor.
